subject.title: message tool should auto-select the only enabled account

question: Should omitted message-tool account IDs infer the single enabled configured account after explicit/default/bound precedence, or should OpenClaw keep requiring an explicit `accountId` or configured `defaultAccount` when the default account is disabled?
rationale: The source gap and repair boundary are clear, but the change alters multi-account fallback semantics and should not land without maintainer acceptance of that product behavior.

options.title: Accept shared resolver policy
options.body: Land or replace the linked candidate with a shared resolver that preserves explicit/default/bound IDs first, then selects an enabled configured default or exactly one enabled configured account with clear zero-or-multiple errors.

options.title: Keep explicit account selection
options.body: Keep current semantics and document that users must set `accountId` or `defaultAccount` when the default account is disabled.

options.title: Require channel-owned fallback
options.body: Ask for channel-owned account inference if maintainers do not want core to own this fallback policy across message channels.

recommendation.title: Accept shared resolver policy
recommendation.body: Land or replace the linked candidate with a shared resolver that preserves explicit/default/bound IDs first, then selects an enabled configured default or exactly one enabled configured account with clear zero-or-multiple errors.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already gave the prior shared-resolver direction and has the clearest history on the fallback-policy decision.
